description: This file defines the class ShoppingCartDataPopulator, which populates shopping cart data objects from shopping cart models in a Java e-commerce application. It includes methods for creating and populating ShoppingCartData objects, and references various services and models related to products, images, pricing, shopping cart calculations, and order summaries.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDataPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for converting ShoppingCart model instances into ShoppingCartData transfer objects, including nested attributes such as items, totals, and images, with dependencies on pricing and calculation services.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ShoppingCartData as the target object for population.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a ShoppingCartData object from a ShoppingCart model, including setting codes, items, totals, images, and attributes, using services for price formatting and calculation.

methods.name: getOrderService
methods.description: Returns the ShoppingCartCalculationService used in the class.

methods.name: getPricingService
methods.description: Returns the PricingService used in the class.

methods.name: setPricingService
methods.description: Sets the PricingService instance for the class.

methods.name: setShoppingCartCalculationService
methods.description: Sets the ShoppingCartCalculationService instance for the class.
